headline: India tops expectations at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, securing 39 medals across disciplines, surpassing pre‑event forecasts.
Asian Games shot put champion Balwinder Dhaliwal, 67, passes away, leaving a legacy in Indian athletics.
Former Olympic gold medallist Abhinav Bindra looks back on his 2008 triumph, calling it the biggest peak of his sporting life, 18 years later.
